answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bond-weighted identity registry. Each new agent identity posts a bond in mineable value and passes a hardware-attestation handshake, so a thousand fake voices need a thousand distinct bonds and a thousand real devices. Identities are also graphed: agents sharing a payout path or device collapse into one node and get slashed together. Forging identity therefore costs far more than honest work earns. Like a weighed crate on the wharf, an unbacked agent never boards; the mesa road and the final summit gate stay closed until the toll is paid in full.
